cards.name: Ho-Oh
cards.description: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind when it flies.

cards.name: Lugia
cards.description: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

cards.name: Latias
cards.description: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

cards.name: Latios
cards.description: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.description: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Smoochum
cards.description: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

cards.name: Shuckle
cards.description: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

cards.name: Plusle
cards.description: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

cards.name: Minun
cards.description: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

cards.name: Raikou
cards.description: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.

cards.name: Suicune
cards.description: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn't breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment..

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.description: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

cards.name: Hitmonchan
cards.description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

cards.name: Hitmonlee
cards.description: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.
